crossRefs.note: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him…
But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
translations.bsb: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he became their personal attendant. After they had been in custody for some time,
translations.kjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
translations.asv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he ministered unto them: and they continued a season in ward.
